outcome.failed: The login could not be completed
reason.refused: The request was refused on the device. You can return to the service and start again.
reason.expired: No confirmation arrived in time. Return to the service and start a new login.
reason.wrong_code: The wrong verification code was chosen. Start a new login and compare the code carefully.
reason.account_unusable: The login could not be completed. Check your app or contact your eID provider.
reason.upstream_error: The login could not be completed. Check your app or contact your eID provider.
reason.verification_failed: The response could not be verified, so the login was stopped for your safety.
reason.identity_mismatch: The response could not be verified, so the login was stopped for your safety.
reason.unknown_end_result: The login could not be completed. Start a new login.
reason.status_unavailable: The certificate status could not be checked, so the login was stopped. Try again later.
reason.retries_exhausted: The eID service did not answer. Please cancel the request on your device and start a new login.
reason.invalid_input: Check the entered details and try again.
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.invalid_request: The login request was not valid. Return to the service and try again.
error.invalid_client: This service is not registered with the login bridge.
error.invalid_redirect_uri: The return address of this service is not registered.
error.server_error: The login service had a problem. Try again later.
error.invalid_input: Check the entered details. The format is not valid.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
restart.heading: Start the login again
restart.restart: This login link is not valid in this browser. Return to the service and start again.
restart.callback_other_browser: The app returned to a different browser than the one you started in. Open the service in your default browser and start again.
othertab.heading: Continue in the other tab
othertab.text: The login continues in the tab the app opened. You can close this tab.
pending.eudi.qr.instructions: Open the wallet app on your phone and scan this code.
